key_pathways: Not a significant CYP450 substrate or inhibitor

avoid_supplements.name: Iron supplements
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Tetracyclines form insoluble complexes with divalent cations (Fe2+), reducing tigecycline absorption and efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Separate administration by at least 2-3 hours; prioritize timing of antibiotic dosing

avoid_supplements.name: Calcium supplements
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Calcium chelation reduces tigecycline bioavailability similar to iron interactions
avoid_supplements.action: Separate administration by at least 2-3 hours; take tigecycline on empty stomach if possible

avoid_supplements.name: Magnesium supplements
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Mg2+ cation complexation impairs tigecycline gastrointestinal absorption
avoid_supplements.action: Administer tigecycline 2-3 hours before or after magnesium-containing products

avoid_supplements.name: Zinc supplements
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Divalent cation chelation reduces tetracycline absorption
avoid_supplements.action: Space doses by at least 2 hours; monitor clinical response

caution_supplements.name: Vitamin K supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: Tigecycline may suppress gut flora producing vitamin K; supplementation may help prevent hypoprothrombinemia with prolonged use
caution_supplements.action: Consider monitoring INR if on warfarin; supplementation generally supportive

caution_supplements.name: Probiotics
caution_supplements.mechanism: Tigecycline disrupts normal microbiota; probiotics may support GI health during treatment
caution_supplements.action: Administer probiotics 2+ hours apart from tigecycline; use well-studied strains

avoid_foods.name: Dairy products (milk, cheese, yogurt)
avoid_foods.mechanism: Calcium in dairy chelates tigecycline, significantly reducing absorption and serum concentrations
avoid_foods.action: Avoid consumption within 2-3 hours of tigecycline dosing; counsel patient on timing

caution_foods.name: Iron-fortified cereals and grains
caution_foods.mechanism: Fortified iron may reduce tigecycline absorption if consumed concurrently
caution_foods.action: Separate consumption by 2+ hours; monitor for adequate clinical response

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: Fat-rich foods may slightly delay tigecycline absorption but do not substantially impair it
caution_foods.action: May take with or without food; consistent timing preferred for optimal levels

monitoring_notes: Tigecycline has minimal CYP450 interactions but significant chelation concerns with divalent cations requiring careful meal/supplement timing. Monitor for GI tolerability, photosensitivity reactions, and tissue penetration efficacy in critically ill patients; counsel patients on strict spacing of cation-containing products to prevent treatment failure.
